scope: Static archaeology for voxel deformation, SDF meshing, terrain paging, and renderer fake-first route.
compile_reason: No runtime source changed in Phase 0. Build would add contention without proving static audit facts.

targets.evidence: ExecuteVoxelPipelineAsync allocates RawVertices, WeldedPositions, TriangleIndices, EdgeVertexX/Y/Z, weldedCounter, normals, curvature, AO, biome, skirt, dirty blend, colors, and cave spawn list per build with Persistent/DataVaultExempt allocators.
targets.risk: Chunk rebuild is async-yielded, but allocator churn can still create frame spikes and memory fragmentation under bursts of laser carving.
targets.required_fix: Move build-sized arrays to DataVault-owned or chunk-pool-owned lanes with explicit capacity budget and no hot growth.

targets.evidence: UploadSurfaceMesh and UploadColliderMesh copy vertices and indices into MeshData in main-thread loops, then ApplyAndDisposeWritableMeshData. Physics bake is deferred through VoxelMeshBakeJob, but mesh upload is still a main-thread cost center.
targets.risk: Geometry rebuild can be time-sliced before upload, then stall when final mesh data is applied.
targets.required_fix: Introduce budgeted upload dispatcher and pooled MeshData staging; keep renderer continuity through Dear Lie clipping while mesh upload trails.

targets.evidence: CarveSdfJob computes writes off-thread, but TryCommitScheduledCarve commits up to MaxScheduledCarveCommitWritesPerFrame on main thread through Dictionary-backed ChunkDeltaState mutation and rebuild enqueue.
targets.risk: Laser carving is not fully nonblocking. Job compute is async; authoritative delta commit remains a bounded main-thread mutation lane.
targets.required_fix: Separate authoritative commit from renderer fake. Keep gameplay-truth commit bounded and move visual response to GPU stamp/clip path.

targets.evidence: _chunkStates, _compactedChunkStates, and _chunkWriteVersions are managed dictionaries. GetOrCreateChunkState grows capacity and ChunkDeltaState constructor allocates four Persistent NativeArrays per new dirty chunk.
targets.risk: First touch of new chunks during combat/mining can allocate and resize on the main thread.
targets.required_fix: Preallocate deterministic NativeParallelHashMap or DataVault-backed chunk state tables by residency budget; keep managed dictionaries cold/editor-only.

targets.evidence: VoxelStreamingScratchSlot is a managed class container. EnsureNativeArrayCapacity disposes and reallocates Persistent NativeArrays when required length grows.
targets.risk: Scratch growth can occur at runtime outside the DataVault ownership doctrine.
targets.required_fix: Bind scratch slot count and capacity to GlobalQualityWeight/residency budget during cold boot; reject hot growth or route growth through DataVault.

targets.evidence: VoxelSurfaceNetsVault defines explicit DTOs, DataVault BufferIDs, telemetry, and GPU upload staging, but no runtime caller was found outside the SurfaceNets package/editor tooling. GpuUploadDispatcher.TryUpload returns false.
targets.risk: A cleaner DataVault meshing lane exists but is not the active deformation pipeline.
targets.required_fix: Either retire as prototype or promote as the active async SDF meshing path with complete upload finalization.

targets.evidence: WorldChunkResidencyManager uses async pager tickets for voxel delta RLE reads. H8BinaryWorldPager also exposes TryReadPageIntoVaultSlice, a synchronous read/decompress path using FileStream under stream lock.
targets.risk: Current residency route is acceptable; future hot callers must not use the sync slice API in gameplay frames.
targets.required_fix: Document and enforce sync slice API as bootstrap/editor/diagnostic only for voxel deltas.

targets.evidence: Shader samples global cut mask and damage volume, but uses them for scar/fresh-cut material response. Fragment and shadow passes do not clip carved volumes, except unrelated chunk dissolve fade.
targets.risk: The visual fake-first path is incomplete. The player sees material damage immediately but geometry voids wait for mesh rebuild.
targets.required_fix: Add continuous-quality GPU carve clip using existing damage volume/cut-mask payloads, with shadow/depth parity and no gameplay authority transfer.

targets.evidence: HectonVoxelVolume.RefreshBakePresentation swaps to voxel bake ghost material while bake state is pending, then back to resolved material when complete.
targets.risk: Current continuity strategy hides bake state but does not display precise carve void before mesh completion.
targets.required_fix: Keep ghost as rebuild-state visual, but layer Dear Lie carve clipping above it for immediate cut response.

targets.evidence: TerrainMaster samples voxel blend mask but has no 3D damage volume or recent carve clipping payload equivalent to AbyssalVoxelRock.
targets.risk: Voxel/terrain boundary can visually desync during delayed mesh rebuilds.
targets.required_fix: Route the same GPU carve payload to terrain boundary material or explicitly mark terrain out of X_006 clip authority.

targets.evidence: VoxelDeltaProcessor and HectonVoxelEngine have 300-frame black boxes, but dump names are legacy SHINOBU/VOXEL_MESH_PIPELINE paths rather than Dump_X_006.bin.
targets.risk: Crash proof exists in pieces but is not unified under the current agent/system acceptance path.
targets.required_fix: Unify X_006 black-box dump naming and include carve, mesh, pager, and shader-fake state hashes.

summary.task01: Voxel pipeline is async-yielded but not allocation-free and not fully free of main-thread upload/commit costs.
summary.task02: Chunk/page infrastructure contains strong DataVault lanes, but active carve state still relies on managed dictionaries and runtime Persistent allocations.
summary.task03: Renderer already has damage volume/cut-mask substrate, but Dear Lie is currently scar shading rather than geometry clip.
